assistant.title: Ask about your field
assistant.intro: Ask about your field, its past seasons or your rotation options. Answers use only figures from the field analysis, and nothing changes until you press Confirm.
assistant.input.label: Your question
assistant.input.placeholder: For example: which rotation held up best?
assistant.step.exclusion: Checking why that crop was left out
assistant.step.slow: Still working. Satellite data can take a moment.

assistant.error.busy: The assistant is busy. Please wait a minute and ask again.
assistant.error.templates: The assistant is not available right now. The comparison and replay views still show every figure.
assistant.error.noField: Choose a field on the map first, then ask about it.
assistant.error.tool: That part of the field analysis is not ready yet: {message}
assistant.review: Local review: check these answers with a local agronomist before you act on them.
assistant.answer.unavailable: This part of the answer could not be shown.
assistant.trace.title: How I got this answer
assistant.trace.empty: No field data was needed for this answer.
